name: First Foothold
rule: Answer your first 20 questions.

name: Topic Clear
rule: Clear your first topic: its lesson done, and 4 of your last 5 answers there right.

name: Ten Topics
rule: Clear 10 topics.

name: Firm Footing
rule: Reach 70% mastery in a domain, with 20 or more of its questions answered. One leaf per domain.

name: Whole Map
rule: Reach 65% mastery in every domain.

name: Loop Closed
rule: Fix 10 logged mistakes: answer each one right, without a hint, on a later day.

name: Slip Spotter
rule: Tag 10 mistakes with the thinking slip behind them.

name: Long Memory
rule: Get 25 questions right, without a hint, a week or more after you last saw them.

name: Beyond Review
rule: Answer 50 questions right from the last review box, so they leave review.

name: Confidence Check
rule: Of your last 50 “sure” answers, get 85% or more right (after at least 20).

name: Dress Rehearsal
rule: Finish a full, timed mock with every question answered.

name: On Pace
rule: Finish a timed mock with every pace check within 10% of the target.

name: Mindset Shift
rule: Pick the closest wrong choice clearly less often than in your first weeks.

name: Steady Days
rule: Study on 10 days in all, then 30, then 60. Days add up; they don’t need to be in a row.

name: Deep Roots
rule: Make one whole topic stick: every part of it answered right, without a hint, on two different days.

name: Fresh Start
rule: Come back after 7 days or more away and finish a session.

name: Trap Spotter
rule: Spot the snare in 8 of your last 10 Snare Spotter questions.

name: Even Keel
rule: Forecast says “well calibrated” 3 rounds in a row.

name: Priority Reader
rule: Read the deciding word right in 8 of your last 10 different FIRST questions in Signpost.

name: Myth Clearer
rule: Clear 20 of your last 25 different rumors in Root or Rumor.

name: Measured Pace
rule: Finish 3 Daylight rounds at Sapling pace or faster, inside the light, with 4 of 5 right.

name: Trail Sampler
rule: Play every game at least once.

name: Course Corrected
rule: Fix 10 game misses later: right on a later day, in review or a later round.
